messages:
nina: FYI during a live walkthrough today the JS sampleapp occasionally renders broken JSON if you close the tab or ctrl+c while the server is streaming. Looks like partial SSE events get emitted on shutdown.
omar: Can you share a minimal repro and any logs?
nina: Yep. Start the sample, trigger a long-running generation, then ctrl+c ~100-300ms after token emission starts. Browser console: JSON.parse error. Node sample prints 'truncated token' and exits non-zero. Logs: 
[info] stream connected
[debug] recv: data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":\" He\"}
[debug] SIGINT
[debug] flush -> \"llo\"
[error] parse failed: Unexpected end of JSON input

kevin: That matches a race in the parser finalization path: finalize() currently emits any remaining buffer even if it doesn't end with the SSE delimiter (\n\n). So half-objects leak out.
ciara: Could auth refresh/reconnect replay be making it worse? If a reconnect replay pushes the same tail chunk while the client aborts we could see duplicate partials in the UI.
omar: Good catch. We saw an internal trace where auth refresh started a reconnect and server sent a final event simultaneously; client abort led to emit of an incomplete object, then reconnect replay pushed another fragment -> duplicate halves.
kevin: Proposed fixes: 1) Parser: on finalize, only emit if buffer contains a full SSE event (endsWith('\n\n') or contains a complete `data:` block). Otherwise drop buffer and log at debug. 2) Sampleapps: implement gracefulShutdown() that waits up to 150ms or polls parser.inFlight flag to let an in-flight event complete before closing. 3) Add DEMO_STRICT_PARSING=false opt-in env var for instructor demos to avoid crashing. 4) Render a friendlier message when JSON.parse fails: \"Stream ended early; partial output omitted.\"
ciara: Can we add unit/integration tests? Simulate mid-chunk SIGINT, auth refresh during stream, and reconnect replay.
kevin: I'll add parser unit tests and a small runtime integration test that toggles auth refresh + client abort.
omar: I'll open a tiny PR for the JS/Python sampleapps w/ graceful shutdown and the env var. Also include a short repro script so docs team can reproduce.
bot-deploy: Note: no active rolling deploys blocking merges; small PRs ok to land. :white_check_mark:
nina: Thanks. Please tag me on the PRs. Also let's add a one-paragraph note to devex onboarding describing recommended demo shutdown steps to reduce helpdesk noise.
ciara: Agree. Once PRs land we'll update onboarding and the sampleapp READMEs.
